h: AY apologises after chaos at his Cardiff comedy show, blames a payment dispute
p: Comedian AY has apologised to fans after his Cardiff show on the UK tour descended into confusion, with ticket holders waiting for hours and police attending. He says he and the other comedians arrived but could not perform because of a payment dispute with the organisers. He has urged the tour management to publish refund details.
more: The dispute was reportedly settled only after most of the crowd had left.
The organisers had not issued a public statement at the time of reporting.
